user.title: Perron Studio
user.description: Choose your Perron board among the ESPHome devices. An access token for the live view and the preview is created and transferred to the board over the encrypted ESPHome connection.

abort.no_esphome: No ESPHome device found. Add the Perron board with the ESPHome integration first.
abort.already_configured: This board is already set up.

show.name: Show tile
show.description: Shows a Perron Studio tile on the board now (voice command, button, automation).

tile.name: Tile
tile.description: Name or id of the tile.

zone.name: Where
zone.description: Full screen, right panel or info line (default: the tile's setting).

hide.name: Hide tile
hide.description: Removes a tile from the board.

tile.name: Tile
tile.description: Name or id of the tile.

show_commute.name: Show commute
show_commute.description: Routes commute 1 or 2 now and shows it full screen.

play_video.name: Play video
play_video.description: Plays any video live on the board: camera entity, media-source id, URL (http/rtsp), allowed local file or GIF. Home Assistant scales it to the layout and streams it.

source.name: Source
source.description: camera.x, media-source://…, http(s)/rtsp URL or an allowed local path.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: f full bleed, b with status bar and info line, s video left and text right, p panel tile next to the departures.

title.name: Title
title.description: Shown with layouts s and p.

loop.name: Loop
loop.description: Repeat short clips and GIFs for the whole duration.

stop_video.name: Stop video
stop_video.description: Ends the video on the board.
